content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The term of this lease shall commence on June 1, 2024, and terminate on May 31, 2029, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_USE_OF_PREMISES
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall use the Premises solely for commercial office purposes, as further detailed in Exhibit A attached hereto.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._RENT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $3,500 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month, commencing June 1, 2024.
